{{Top}} {{Conjecture}} {{Droid |type=Criminal |image=[[File:LEP-series-droid-TBOBF.png]] |name=Unidentified LEP-series service droid |homeworld= |birth= |death= |creator= |manufacturer= |line= |model= |class=[[LEP-series service droid]]{{BOBF|Chapter 4: The Gathering Storm}} |cost= |length= |width= |height= |mass= |gender= |pronouns= |sensor=[[Color|Yellow]] |plating=Brown and white |armament= |equipment=A [[net]] |affiliation=*[[Jabba's criminal empire]] *[[Fett gotra]] }} {{Quote|Quick little bugger.|Boba Fett|}} An '''LEP-series service droid''' was employed as a [[Tatoo-rat|ratcatcher]] in the [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] of [[crime lord]] [[Boba Fett]]. Originally serving under [[Bib Fortuna]], the [[LEP-series service droid|LEP droid]] encountered Fett when the latter [[Firespray heist|infiltrated]] the castle around [[9 ABY]]. The [[droid]] deactivated itself in fear of the former [[bounty hunter]] after a chase in the palace kitchen. Later, when Fett returned and [[Attack on Jabba's Palace (Boba Fett)|killed]] Fortuna, the LEP droid continued its service under him. ==Biography== {{Quote|What was that?''"
"''I don't know. More rats?''"
"''Go find it. I will contact the rat catcher.|The palace cook droid and its sous-chef|}} Around [[9 ABY]],{{MandoDate|5}} The flashbacks of ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'' Chapter 4 take place, in part, at the same time as Chapter 5 of ''The Mandalorian''. the [[LEP-series service droid]] was summoned to the [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] kitchen by a [[Unidentified COO-series cook droid|cook droid]], whose [[EV-series supervisor droid|EV-series]] [[Unidentified EV-series sous-chef droid|sous-chef]] suspected that [[tatoo-rat]]s had infested the area. Upon arriving at the kitchen, however, the ratcather discovered the two [[droid]]s subdued not by [[rat]]s, but by [[Boba Fett]] and [[Fennec Shand]], who had [[Firespray heist|infiltrated]] the palace to retrieve [[Slave I|Fett's ship]]. The ratcatcher attempted to run away, skittering around the kitchen and through the oven as Fett attacked it with a [[Boba Fett's gaderffii stick|gaderffii stick]]. It was almost able to escape until cornered by Shand, giving Fett the opportunity to grab the little droid by its neck and announce himself. Terrified of the former [[bounty hunter]], the ratcatcher flipped its own deactivation switch. Fett dumped the droid in a bin, leaving to take back his [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft|''Firespray'' gunship]], ''[[Slave I]]''. Sometime later, the two criminals returned to the palace and [[Attack on Jabba's Palace (Boba Fett)|assassinated]] Fortuna, taking the castle as their own. With its previous owner [[Death|dead]], the ratcatcher became a part of the [[Fett gotra]], serving the new [[Daimyo]] as he welcomed members of other [[Tatooine]] crime families. During a diplomatic dinner with the family heads, [[Boba's rancor|Fett's rancor]] startled the droid from within his pit, prompting it to scurry away. Shortly after, Fett successfully [[Battle of Mos Espa|fended off]] the forces of the [[Pyke Syndicate]] during a [[War against the Pykes|gang war]] for the [[planet]]. He celebrated his victory with a stroll through the streets of [[Mos Espa]], accompanied by members of his crime family, including the ratcatcher droid.{{BOBF|Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor}} ==Characteristics== {{Quote|Do you know who I am?''"
[sobbing]
"''I am Boba Fett.|The droid's short conversation with Fett, before deactivating itself|}} The ratcatcher was a small LEP-series [[service droid]] with [[Color|white]] and brown plating and yellow [[sensor]]s. Quick and nimble, it was able to avoid the strikes of Boba Fett's [[gaderffii stick]], weaving in and around the palace kitchen. It was also somewhat flame resistant, able to survive a crawl through a tubular oven without damage. The ratcatcher was a fearful, easily intimidated droid; it chose to deactivate itself rather than face Fett and, though it was physically incapable of actual crying, emitted sobbing noises when faced with distress. ==Equipment== The ratcatcher patrolled the palace with a small triangular [[net]]. ==Behind the scenes== The LEP droid first appeared in "[[Chapter 4: The Gathering Storm]]," the fourth episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'', which premiered on [[January 19]], [[2022]]. ==Appearances== *{{BOBF|Chapter 4: The Gathering Storm}} {{1st}} *{{BOBF|Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/the-book-of-boba-fett-cargo-hold-chapter-4|text=''The Book of Boba Fett'' Cargo Hold: "Chapter 4: The Gathering Storm"}} {{Po}} *{{SW|url=news/the-book-of-boba-fett-chapter-4-highlights|text=The Best of ''The Book of Boba Fett'': 5 Highlights from "Chapter 4: The Gathering Storm"}} *{{SW|url=news/the-book-of-boba-fett-quotes|text=20 Great Quotes From ''The Book of Boba Fett''}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=სერია LEP-ის უცნობი მომსახურე დროიდი }} [[Category:Droids of the Hutt Clan]] [[Category:LEP servant droids]] [[Category:Members of the Fett gotra]]
